name: n8n
description: Fair-code workflow automation platform with native AI capabilities. Combine visual building with custom code, self-host or cloud, 400+ integrations.
one_liner: A drag-and-drop tool for connecting your apps together and automating repetitive tasks, like 'when a new order comes in, add it to my spreadsheet and text me', without needing to write code.
buyer: A small business owner or ops manager doing repetitive manual data entry between apps (orders, spreadsheets, email, CRM) who can't afford custom software.
business_use_cases: A local business owner automates order-to-invoice-to-inventory updates across their existing apps instead of manually copying data between them.
A freelance automation consultant builds and sells custom workflows to small businesses, charging per workflow built.
An agency builds AI-powered customer-service or lead-qualification workflows for clients using its native AI nodes.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a business-process-automation service, building and maintaining custom workflows for small business clients
Sell one-off custom workflow builds for a specific repetitive task a client describes

steal_this: This weekend, find one local business doing a repetitive manual task (like copying orders into a spreadsheet), automate it with a single workflow, and charge a flat setup fee plus a small monthly maintenance fee.
